descriptions.pc98:189332: Explore AliceSoft's early work through a quiz, a CG gallery, user feedback, and two short adventures. This collection plays like an interactive studio scrapbook rather than one continuous game.
descriptions.pc98:189333: AliceSoft's second interactive collection includes three short games, a large quiz, and reader submissions. Browse its menu for developer commentary, music, artwork, and other extras.
descriptions.pc98:190347: Eimmy searches for her missing stepbrother after debt collectors tear apart her family life. This illustrated adventure follows her investigation and the contrasting personality she discovers within herself.
descriptions.pc98:440344: A psychological horror RPG made with Dante98. A choice at a train platform leads the protagonist into an uncanny carriage, where checking passengers' tickets becomes part of a disturbing journey.
descriptions.pc98:195490: Transfer student Nanako investigates suspicious examinations at St. Belloncho Academy. The school adventure mixes dialogue and mystery solving with fights against an eccentric group of students.
descriptions.pc98:189256: Ares loses the magical Planet Buster sword when a warlock captures him in the desert. Escape the prison, recover the weapon, and continue the dungeon-crawling sequel in this revised release.
descriptions.pc98:139265: Fight through connected side-scrolling stages as Gady and, at times, Sephina. The action RPG combines melee combat, platforming, boss fights, and a town where the party can recover and save.
descriptions.pc98:187084: Choose or customize an adventurer, accept a quest from Mareen, and explore first-person dungeons for a target monster and magical item. Character statistics, equipment, and turn-based encounters shape each expedition.
descriptions.pc98:189337: Three independent illustrated adventures are presented as cartridges for a fictional Dream Program System. Each short scenario offers a choice of protagonist or personality that changes how its story unfolds.
descriptions.pc98:183307: Doctor Tanchi investigates a crime syndicate tied to his family's past while an assassin threatens his hospital. This adventure alternates command-based investigation with one-on-one turn-based battles.
descriptions.pc98:179041: Take a series of pop-culture and science-fiction quizzes to gain entry to Cybernetic Hi-School. Version 2.0 revises the original with its own boot system, larger graphics, and faster presentation.
descriptions.pc98:156050: A journalist investigates a remote island research facility with possible military ties. His inquiry intersects with an amnesiac girl and a manager who suspects the experiments hide something dangerous.
descriptions.pc98:187132: Knight Landis enters a lakeside tower to rescue a kidnapped princess. Explore vector-drawn first-person mazes alone, buy equipment between trips, and survive random turn-based battles.
descriptions.pc98:197630: Future police officer Milk and schoolgirl Kurumi are forced to share a body after a strange encounter. Their short illustrated adventure pits them against Amon, who turns plants into monsters.
descriptions.pc98:197631: Milk and Kurumi continue their shared-body mission against Amon's plant monsters. The second short episode advances their animated science-fiction adventure.
descriptions.pc98:442277: Orphaned Ken moves into the home of a wealthy woman who knew his father. Explore the household and its tangled relationships through illustrated scenes and adventure-game choices.
descriptions.pc98:183344: Command the Blue army as it defends its capital from an invasion by the Red nation. This campaign moves directly between tactical battles, with units fighting to hold city positions and rescue captives.
descriptions.pc98:189394: A short AliceSoft command adventure starring a policewoman. Originally distributed with early releases of Rance, it stands as a compact side story rather than a full-length RPG.
descriptions.pc98:187220: Student Yuuji shelters an amnesiac cat-eared girl he finds after news of a stolen tiger. The first GaoGao adventure follows their growing relationship through illustrated story scenes and choices.
descriptions.pc98:187222: A failed biological experiment leaves the future Earth divided between protected human domes and a dangerous mutant wilderness. Explore the second GaoGao story through illustrated scenes and decisions.
descriptions.pc98:187678: The fourth GaoGao story returns to a world split between human shelters and mutated tribes. Two protagonists search for Canaan, a promised refuge, as the remaining civilization struggles to survive.
descriptions.pc98:203804: The SIS crew investigates an abandoned spacecraft after two members develop a mysterious illness. This short, heavily animated science-fiction adventure follows the consequences of their encounter.
descriptions.pc98:181173: Race in a PC-98 Grand Prix game from West Side, released in 1990. Compete on circuits and manage the demands of high-speed driving rather than navigating an adventure story.
descriptions.pc98:195517: Ayayo takes a part-time job in Mr. Suzuki's shop in this short illustrated adult story. Occasional choices alter parts of the narrative, which includes animated scenes.
descriptions.pc98:183493: A reluctant descendant of a legendary hero inherits a magical sword as the demon lord Gargantua threatens to return. Explore a fantasy world and fight to stop his revival.
descriptions.pc98:187301: Kazuya joins a robotic resistance leader against a government that controls people with PSYCO technology. Fight brainwashed opponents and pursue the regime in this adult science-fiction game.
descriptions.pc98:187303: After the first game's revolt, Kazuya discovers that the PSYCO mind-control program has resurfaced at a school. The sequel sends him against another group of affected opponents.
descriptions.pc98:187371: Robbed on his return to a town with an unresolved mystery, a young man enters its mahjong circuit to earn money and uncover what happened to a woman he once saw attacked.
descriptions.pc98:195536: Demon hunters Lime and Bass enter the human world to recover jewels stolen by BEM creatures. The first episode presents their mission as a short animated adventure with occasional command choices.
descriptions.pc98:470408: Lime returns in a short animated adventure divided into three areas that can be visited in any order. Story scenes carry most of the episode, with limited interaction.
descriptions.pc98:470410: Lime and Bass continue hunting jewel-stealing BEM creatures in the third episode. It plays like an interactive cartoon, advancing its animated story through simple command selections.
descriptions.pc98:470413: The fourth episode places Lime at a restaurant, where Bass and an unusual octopus complicate her day. Its brief animated scenes continue the series' lightly interactive format.
descriptions.pc98:470837: At a costume convention, Lime encounters a living bag that steals outfits. This fifth installment is a short animated story with the series' familiar characters and sparse interaction.
descriptions.pc98:470838: A trip to the swimming pool turns strange when a sunfish stuns the visitors. Bass confronts the creature's demonic owner in the sixth short, animated episode.
descriptions.pc98:470839: Bass's stomach escapes on its own, sending the group after it in the seventh Jewel Bem Hunter Lime episode. The story unfolds through brief animated scenes.
descriptions.pc98:470840: Lime and her companions visit a circus in the eighth installment, where the outing quickly goes awry. This is another short, animation-led episode.
descriptions.pc98:470841: Lime faces a double who is impersonating Bass and causing trouble. The ninth episode continues the series through animated story scenes and light interaction.
descriptions.pc98:470843: The tenth installment is a roughly ten-minute animated story set at a bathhouse. Unlike the earlier episodes, it has essentially no player interaction.
descriptions.pc98:470844: Bass and the group attend an idol event, then run into a troublesome turtle when the girls join the performance. The eleventh episode is a short animated story.
descriptions.pc98:470842: Lime is kidnapped, leaving Bass to rescue her in the series' twelfth and final installment. The animated finale closes the group's long-running adventure.
descriptions.pc98:156032: Takuya finds a device that lets him travel between parallel worlds while searching for his missing father. The branching adventure links clues across timelines and follows several intertwined lives.
descriptions.pc98:470421: Thunder-wielding adventurer Raidy investigates a tower whose monsters have been abducting villagers. Explore its first-person corridors, gather equipment, and fight through the dungeon.
descriptions.pc98:219471: Yumi investigates a secluded academy after a friend sent there disappears. This illustrated adult adventure follows a single story path, with occasional context-sensitive choices.
descriptions.pc98:190331: Saiko travels across a board-like map and challenges magical creatures at mahjong. Shops, treasure, and other spaces give the matches a light role-playing framework.
descriptions.pc98:183374: Hunt Gorgus, the man who killed your father, across towns and monster-filled dungeons. This top-down RPG uses turn-based battles, equipment, and side quests to build the hero's strength.
descriptions.pc98:187422: Follow apprentice sorceress Arle through three linked first-person dungeon RPGs at different stages of her life. Spell choices and status conveyed through portraits replace the usual visible statistic display.
descriptions.pc98:197770: College student Hiroaki tries to understand the strange luck that seems to shape his encounters and grant his wishes. This adult illustrated adventure follows his investigation of that power.
descriptions.pc98:198851: Choose from five fighters for overhead arena duels. Each character wields two attack objects that can also block; win by draining an opponent's health or knocking them out of the ring.
descriptions.pc98:187467: In an alternate Japan shaped by the science of meta-topology, a school of gifted young women becomes central to an old political conflict. This illustrated adventure mixes science-fiction history with campus drama.
descriptions.pc98:183384: Knight Eagle Windeed pursues a way to restore balance to a world whose four elements have fallen into conflict. Travel between kingdoms, meet allies, and battle threats in this fantasy RPG.
descriptions.pc98:187543: Mercenary Rance is hired to investigate trouble at a factory developing Happiness Medicine. Clear monsters from the premises while using menu commands and turn-based combat in this side story.
descriptions.pc98:187544: Rance and the Angel Team continue the Happiness Medicine factory investigation begun in Rance 4.1. The second half keeps its menu-based exploration and turn-based battles.
descriptions.pc98:187546: Rance and Sill are hired to recover four stolen magic rings and stop the sorceresses terrorizing Custom Town. Explore, investigate, and fight through this fantasy adventure RPG.
descriptions.pc98:157675: Out of money again, Rance accepts a rescue job near the Kingdom of Leazas. A trip into a monster-filled cave grows into a larger fantasy adventure with exploration and combat.
descriptions.pc98:187547: Rance and Sill become involved in the legacy of a decades-long war between humanity and demons. The fourth main adventure expands the series' fantasy exploration and party battles.
descriptions.pc98:187563: Private investigator Rance is sent to find Hikari, a student missing from Paris High School. Navigate locations through first-person menus, gather clues, and fight through the opening game of the series.
descriptions.pc98:198821: A former opponent from Réserve sets out to become human. Cross a short board-game route, defeat three rivals, and collect the essences needed for the desired ending.
descriptions.pc98:190913: Organize a footrace to bring attention to a struggling village. This side-scrolling racing game supports computer opponents and a two-player mode with selectable stages.
descriptions.pc98:198820: Guide a pink-haired heroine across a board of hostile encounters. Battles test memory by asking for the right pair of answers, while wrong choices lead to alternate outcomes.
descriptions.pc98:197833: New student Shuji starts at Kotobuki Preparatory School and gets to know his classmates. This school-life adventure follows conversations and relationship choices across the term.
descriptions.pc98:197834: Koichi's brother plans revenge against the family he blames for their father's downfall. Koichi moves nearby to win their trust, pulling him into a drama of family secrets and conflicting loyalties.
descriptions.pc98:187601: Akira gathers five girls with special powers to defend the Laker Crystals from the Gadram Empire. The first Lakers game combines story scenes with turn-based tactical battles.
descriptions.pc98:187602: Akira and the Lakers face Rayott, a new enemy seeking the crystals to invade Earth. The sequel continues their story through cutscenes and turn-based team battles.
descriptions.pc98:187603: A masked enemy called Neos Bullard attacks the Lakers for the crystals' power. The third installment retains ranged tactical battles while adding new threats to Akira's team.
descriptions.pc98:183431: Three free generals must reclaim Hyunckel's castles and rescue companions captured by dark forces. The sequel focuses on turn-based tactical campaigns across a fantasy kingdom.
descriptions.pc98:183567: Student Yusuke experiences violent visions that blur dream and reality. This psychological horror visual novel follows his efforts to uncover their source and survive the danger around him.
descriptions.pc98:198815: Explore an Egyptian tomb in a horror RPG built with RPG Maker Dante98 II. Archaeological clues and a trapped expedition lead the party deeper into a story inspired by the Book of the Dead.
descriptions.pc98:186488: A spacefaring hunter confronts the mysterious VOID attacks amid growing tension between human factions and the Galaxy Alliance. The sequel mixes first-person 3D shooting with exploration and story sequences.
descriptions.pc98:197860: Detective Shinobu Aiba infiltrates a prestigious private school to investigate a series of disappearances. Advance this 1991 Orange House mystery by choosing commands and following clues around campus.
descriptions.pc98:134846: A Macross visual novel and strategy collection that combines Skull Leader with Love Stories. It retells familiar events using the film's designs while drawing on the television series for additional story material.
descriptions.pc98:122360: Reimu investigates the destruction of the Hakurei Shrine in the first Touhou game. Bat the Yin-Yang Orb through enemies and obstacles in a shrine-maiden take on block-breaking action.
descriptions.pc98:125780: Reimu returns to a shrine overrun by ghosts and heads out to find their source. The second Touhou game changes the series to vertical shooting, with stages, bosses, and the Yin-Yang Orbs.
descriptions.pc98:125781: A strange ruin promises to grant one visitor's wish, drawing Reimu and other rivals into a contest. This Touhou entry uses competitive split-screen shooting against another player or the computer.
descriptions.pc98:125782: Choose Reimu or Marisa and fight through a vertical shooter with character-specific attacks and bombs. The fourth Touhou game sends them after the disturbance spreading from the dream world.
descriptions.pc98:125783: Demons flow from Makai into Gensokyo, prompting Reimu and other playable characters to seek the source. The fifth Touhou game is a vertical shooter with individual weapons and boss encounters.
descriptions.pc98:156156: Spend a summer meeting classmates, friends, and other potential partners in a college-life dating simulation. Schedule activities and make choices that shape which relationship develops.
descriptions.pc98:187687: Bunny-eared warrior Ramy protects people and animals from hostile creatures, beginning aboard a penguin-filled ship. Jump, dash, and use her sword through side-scrolling action stages.
descriptions.pc98:156033: Women fighters representing family restaurants enter a national martial-arts tournament. Choose a competitor and fight through the Variable Geo roster in one-on-one matches.
descriptions.pc98:183085: Kendo captain and Asuka face a strained relationship when his cousin Miki moves in. This animated Viper follow-up uses occasional choices to steer its adult drama.
descriptions.pc98:183088: Ogawa summons the demon Carrera again, but she arrives with Mercedes and an angel soon interrupts them. The Viper sequel is an adult animated story with limited player input.
descriptions.pc98:183093: Two animated stories, Rise and Imagine, make up this Viper volume. Rise follows martial artist Akira after she and her friends are taken by a hidden subterranean group.
descriptions.pc98:440348: Siblings Meena and Otto can channel spiritual energy into magic. A request to gather healing plants leads them into a trap in a forest, beginning a fantasy RPG journey.
descriptions.pc98:191573: Soldier Kiyomi is sent after four escaped prisoners in a war-scarred future Tokyo. Investigate scenes and people through point-and-click interactions in this science-fiction adventure.
descriptions.pc98:198823: A comic cast faces off in a translated doujin fighting game. Choose a character and battle through exaggerated attacks and humor in the Yugekitai series.
descriptions.pc98:198852: The Yugekitai punk band discovers a plot to revive the destructive god Susanoo. Their comedic adventure follows the group as it tries to stop the scheme.
descriptions.pc98:156061: Begin as an early creature and survive a succession of prehistoric eras on the way to Eden. Spend evolution points to reshape its body and abilities, then save favored designs in the Book of Life.
descriptions.pc98:186976: Pilot a BD-5J jet in ten aerobatic events, including pylon races, slaloms, and ribbon-cutting stunts. Up to four players can compete across four difficulty levels.
descriptions.pc98:187676: Play as Triton in a first-person, point-and-click fantasy quest to recover four swords. Travel between surreal realms and solve environmental puzzles in a PC-98 adventure with anime-style art.
descriptions.pc98:156062: Warrior Gento and his feline companion Benimaru journey across Japan after Edo soldiers attack them. Their search leads to a plot to release a dragon god sealed long ago.
descriptions.pc98:197578: After a dream and an earthquake carry Shounosuke into another world, he must help six girls across separate scenarios. Exploration and story scenes are tied to puzzles built by placing path pieces.
descriptions.pc98:184546: Route a train through real-time rail puzzles, collecting passengers before reaching the exit. Switch junctions to avoid collisions, with several maps available from the start.
descriptions.pc98:156065: Command a mercenary squad through missions ranging from infiltration to a coup leader's assassination. Pause the real-time action to give orders and choose Attacker, Defender, Sniper, or Commander mechs for each job.
descriptions.pc98:156066: A resurrection drug turns its subjects into zombies, and Cole and its inventor Dr. Cooger race to contain the outbreak. Investigate the spreading disaster through graphic-adventure scenes and choices.
descriptions.pc98:156067: Cole and Sheila thought the zombie crisis was over, but a new death suggests the resurrection drug survived. The sequel returns to their investigation as violence spreads through the city.
descriptions.pc98:156125: Queen Luna sends an adventurer into the Goddess Tower after a dragon and its knights threaten Strawberry Fields. Explore first-person levels, fight monsters, and work down toward the tower's source of evil.
descriptions.pc98:156124: Witch Mesaana has cursed the people of Strawberry Fields, turning some into monsters. Takeru searches three dungeons for sacred writings that can undo the spell in this fantasy RPG sequel.
descriptions.pc98:183171: Prince Selios escapes imprisonment after a trusted ally betrays him. Gather companions, cross the kingdom, and fight turn-based battles on his quest to reclaim the throne.
descriptions.pc98:156054: Switch between detective Kojiroh and intelligence agent Marina as separate cases converge on a serial murder mystery. The Multi-Sight structure reveals clues from each protagonist's perspective.
descriptions.pc98:156122: Knight Arc and his friend Randia return to find their town invaded and priestess Ferio abducted. Lead a party through turn-based tactical maps to rescue her from the Black Knight's forces.
descriptions.pc98:175461: On Arc's coronation day, demons steal the sacred sword from its shrine. The new king and his companions pursue it through a tactical RPG campaign that follows the first Farland Story.
descriptions.pc98:175465: Princess Kushna flees an unwanted marriage decision and is drawn into a conflict beyond her castle. Lead her allies across turn-based tactical maps in this separate Farland Story campaign.
descriptions.pc98:175466: Thief Grey helps sisters Elicia and her sibling escape their pursuers, uncovering a wider conspiracy. The sixth Farland Story shifts to a world with Western and science-fiction touches while retaining tactical battles.
descriptions.pc98:175463: Rebels Darland and Phir flee the despot Pepper and gather support to end his rule. This new Farland Story cast fights a succession of turn-based map battles.
descriptions.pc98:175462: Arc and Ferio shelter an amnesiac girl called Fana, whose nightmares hint at a dangerous past. Escort her to an archbishop and fight through the tactical battles that follow.
descriptions.pc98:189374: Reassemble moving pictures by sliding their tiles before time runs out. FlixMix offers several puzzle modes that change how pieces are moved and grouped.
descriptions.pc98:187207: Climb the monster-filled Tower of Gage in a roguelike quest against the Dark Lord Mick Albert. Recruit allies and collect equipment as the party advances through its floors.
descriptions.pc98:180890: Two decades after nuclear strikes destroy Tokyo, survivors live in underground shelters while demons roam above. Join the Devil Busters to defend the shelters and explore the ruined city in this Megami Tensei RPG.
descriptions.pc98:189246: Choose one of three heroes for a board-based strategy RPG journey. The computer directs the other two as the group faces roaming monsters and rival forces.
descriptions.pc98:186567: Luna pursues the truth behind a laboratory disaster and her sister's disappearance. Experimental bioloader armor and Val-Kaizer draw her into a fast-moving science-fiction action story.
descriptions.pc98:189396: Kentarou and Miki continue their journey after escaping Dracula's castle in Little Princess. This early Champion Soft adventure follows their attempt to find a way home through illustrated scenes.
descriptions.pc98:133232: A supernatural catastrophe mutates and ruins Tokyo. Explore the city, speak with survivors, and follow the chosen people who may be able to stop the destruction.
descriptions.pc98:187450: Apprentice magician Marble accidentally releases a demon with her master's Wand of Wishes. Cross single-screen puzzle stages with help from the wand's spirit, Sirius, to repair the damage.
descriptions.pc98:183054: Choose one of five wizards and compete for a leaderless realm. Summon monsters to seize towers on hex-grid maps; surviving units can carry over through a full campaign.
descriptions.pc98:156056: Rei, a pilot in the Steel Fox squad, assaults the Slave Dog terrorist base in a heavily armed suit. Night Slave pairs side-scrolling shooting and boss fights with an animated science-fiction story.
descriptions.pc98:189844: Wake in a spaceship's cryogenic chamber with little memory and signs that something is wrong aboard. Explore its rooms, meet crew members, and choose dialogue as the mystery develops.
descriptions.pc98:189697: Set the conditions for a new universe and watch life evolve from its beginning. This simulation lets the player shape cosmic structure and follow the consequences across immense spans of time.
descriptions.pc98:156145: Escape Jaffar's palace dungeons and reach the imprisoned princess before time runs out. Precise jumps, traps, guard fights, and rotoscoped movement define this cinematic platformer.
descriptions.pc98:189268: Space pirate Kenny searches for his missing father across more than a dozen planets. Buy and sell goods, take jobs, and respond to changing local prices in a space adventure with strategy elements.
descriptions.pc98:189715: Move and fight through a surreal fantasy RPG by learning its unusual keyboard commands. Encounters become typing challenges, making touch-typing skill as important as character progress.
descriptions.pc98:142443: Rusty Springcul enters Bloodthorne Castle after villagers are abducted and transformed into monsters. Fight through side-scrolling stages with a whip and other weapons to confront Bloody Mary.
descriptions.pc98:179035: Sorceress Lina and swordsman Gourry pursue a valuable dragon fang, only to stumble into a larger adventure. Explore, meet familiar Slayers characters, and battle across the fantasy world.
descriptions.pc98:182453: Pilot a Motor Shell mech for a mercenary squad stationed aboard the Dragonet. Routine space missions turn into a wider fight against an invading force in this story-driven combat game.
descriptions.pc98:156060: Blondia and Fallandia fly fighter craft against the war machines of rulers driven mad by a virus. This scrolling shooter sends the siblings into each domain to deliver an antidote.
descriptions.pc98:183445: Create a party and travel through Forcelia, the fantasy setting of the Sword World tabletop RPG. Take quests, explore settlements and dungeons, and resolve encounters using the game's role-playing rules.
descriptions.pc98:191004: Guide Dante through ten stages inspired by the Inferno, fighting demons and crossing platforming hazards. Virgil offers guidance while a chargeable crucifix serves as Dante's main weapon.
descriptions.pc98:183256: Assemble adventurers in Utsuro and descend the Black Tower to seek an artifact said to grant eternal youth. Map its first-person maze, manage the party, and survive turn-based encounters.
descriptions.pc98:156671: Enter BIAS, the dangerous complex beneath Beast City, after creatures disrupt the system the city depends on. The Screamer alternates first-person dungeon exploration with side-scrolling battles.
descriptions.pc98:183448: Custom enters nearby dungeons to train for the Battling Gods Championship. Gain experience and equipment through turn-based fights before taking on the tournament.
descriptions.pc98:168776: Lead Tuned Heart, a crime-fighting squad confronting mind-controlled gangs in city streets. Choose missions, develop team members, and customize their vehicles for turn-based tactical battles.
descriptions.pc98:190873: The Avatar is stranded on Pagan, a world under the Guardian's control. Explore its settlements and wilderness, master the elemental powers, and find a route home past the Titans.
descriptions.pc98:187703: The shattering of the Words Worth tablet sparks war between the surface and underground tribes. Guide Astral through first-person dungeons to discover the culprit and restore peace.
descriptions.pc98:183481: Latok and fairy Pixie hunt a necromancer trying to summon a new demon into Xak. Explore connected regions, gain strength, and fight monsters in real time in this action RPG sequel.
descriptions.pc98:156059: Student Kouji repeatedly dreams of a mysterious space station and its crew. His teacher urges him to investigate, and the line between the dream and his waking life begins to dissolve.
descriptions.pc98:183795: Adol searches for six stolen books that preserve the secret of ancient Ys. Explore towns and wilderness, upgrade equipment, and defeat enemies through the series' real-time bump combat.
